text:
jamie: :rotating_light: Heads up — started smoke rollout v1.12.3 -> 5% traffic (route: /v1/generate). Seeing a jump in 5xx from the canary pool in us-west-2 within the last 3 minutes, healthy-checks failing on ~3/6 canaries.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260715-001. Alert rule `canary-5xx-rate` triggered (5xx rate > 2% over 1m). Paging on-call.

sara: oncall here, ack. jumping in. any obvious recent infra changes?

jamie: nope infra unchanged. Deploy was straight rollout of runtime + small batching tweak (reduce batch timeout from 40 -> 20ms). I rolled the image to the canary set at 1764123420.

devon: looking at logs now. early signs point to increased `backpressure` errors in the runtime and streaming connections hitting `upstream reset`. grabbing stack traces.

marta: attaching recent nginx access tail from canary node (cut):
```
2025-07-15T14:03:02Z 10.2.11.45 "POST /v1/generate" 200 1283 0.041
2025-07-15T14:03:10Z 10.2.11.46 "POST /v1/generate" 502 0 0.000
2025-07-15T14:03:12Z 10.2.11.45 "POST /v1/generate" 504 0 0.300
2025-07-15T14:03:14Z 10.2.11.47 "POST /v1/generate" 200 1400 0.035
```

kevin: production kill-switch is `feature.rollout.v1_12_3.enabled` in the admin console. We can flip it to `false` for the canary shards only. Recommend triggering abort criteria: 5xx > 1.5% for 2 consecutive minutes OR error budget burn > 50% in 5m. We're past that.

jamie: agree — abort canary. @marta can you run the abort? steps in runbook: `rbxctl rollout abort --service inference --tag v1.12.3 --scope canary`

marta: running now. output:
```
$ rbxctl rollout abort --service inference --tag v1.12.3 --scope canary
Aborting rollout v1.12.3 (canary)...
Removing canary traffic routing rules...done
Restoring previous routing config...done
```

ops-bot: Rollback event logged. Rollout v1.12.3 (canary) aborted at 1764123489. Notifying infra and release owner.

devon: after abort, 5xx rate on canaries dropped back to baseline within 45s. No increase seen on stable pool. Good sign — no cascade.

jamie: customer impact assessment: small subset (~0.7% of traffic) saw 502/504. No data loss; sessions retried by client. No SLOs breached for overall production window but incident still warrants postmortem because rollback criterion triggered.

sara: leaving handoff notes for night oncall (@oncall-night):
- incident INC-20260715-001: smoke rollout v1.12.3 aborted due to elevated 5xx in us-west-2 canaries.
- immediate mitigation: aborted canary, restored routing, flagged image `v1.12.3` as blocked.
- followups: collect full traces for affected requests, validate batching change interaction with KV cache and runtime backpressure.
- contact list: jamie (release), devon (runtime), marta (deployment ops), kevin (prod infra).

oncall-night: acked. will monitor overnight and reach out if recurrence.

marta: created a temp feature flag `blocked_rollouts/v1_12_3` and set to `true` across all regions to prevent accidental retry. Added deploy freeze tag in releases dashboard.

kevin: quick note for postmortem: add a canary traffic split test that isolates batching change from runtime changes (A/B), and expand healthcheck verbosity to include `backend-stream-latency` to catch this earlier.

jamie: thanks all. I'll open the incident writeup and assign action items. :white_check_mark:
